msContents.summary: Royal oath of Harsiesis, son of Peteharsomtus before Praktor Milon. He obligates himself to cause the non-paying priests in Edfou to deliver the requested royal linen for the treasury. Subscription in Greek with summary of content.

msItem.title: royal oath concerning debt collection of linen

support.note: The papyrus is still mounted on paper (04/2016).

list.item: object's condition: complete The edges are damaged by several holes. Holes stringedalong the folding.
text's condition: complete Partly heavily faded. Some holes with minor text losses.

23rd regnal year, Phamenoth, of Pharaoh Ptolemaios (III.), son of Ptolemaios (II.),
and of the Female Pharaoh Berenike (II.), { the gods Adelphoi,} the gods Euergetai.
Harpaesis, son of Peteharsomtous is the one who speaks: I take the oath to Pharaoh mentioned above:
You scribes, who are responsible for the royal linen, and you scribes of Horus of Edfou,
(and) of the gods Adelphoi (and) the gods Euergetai: I will give it apart from the ¼ - beyond the place-
-of-oath and the place-of-protection.
Harsiesis, son of Peteharsomtus, the inspector of the temple in Edfou [is the one who speaks to]
[the attorney Euph]ronios, praktor of the temple in the district of [Edfou].
I take an oath in the name of Pharaoh Ptolemaios (III.),
[son of] Ptolemaios (II.), and of the Female Pharaoh Berenike (II.),
of the gods Adelphoi, of the Gods Euergetai, and of Isis and Osiris
and of all gods of Egypt: Those people, who have been high priest in the temple of Edfou,
who owe arrears for the royal linen, I will give it(?) in the hand(?)
of --?-- and of your attorney beyond the place-of-oath and the place-of-protection.
I will let the scribes of the temple sit with your representative,
[so that they control] the arrears, in order to note them. I shall take care of the arrears
[///], as I will not delay them (scil. their payment). That (amount), which the scribes of the temples will not
[declare] for everyone, by prescribing him for payment, with this I shall provide your representative,
as the wine(?) of the temple will be registered, which I will not let be made ..?.. mentioned above(?)
--?—If I will take the oath
as a true oath, I shall be among among those who are favored by Pharaoh,
If I will take it as a false one, I shall be punished Instead of rm „Tränen“ (Spiegelberg), cf. Den Brinker / Muhs / Vleeming, DBL (2005), 202..
[///] Harsiesis, (son of) Peteharsomtus. He says: I will act according to every word mentioned above.
23rd regnal year, 20th of Phamenoth. The oath of Harsieses,
the representative of the epistates Skonometis, the
priest in Edfou under the (following) condition:
The debtors of the linen [///]
he will assign to Andron, (furthermore:) The temple arrears,
he will produce them.
